policy: Reuse these origins across finite local sessions. Verify the preceding owned fixture has exited; fail on an occupied port instead of allocating a new browser origin or stopping an unrelated listener. Keep generated logs, receipts and fixture data unique per session. Product-private upstream ports may remain dynamic because browsers access only the gateway origin.
scope: Local simulated-client acceptance only; does not change production listeners, browser security settings, or authorize real hardware. Port stability alone is not proof that upload/download tooling is unblocked.
